product_metadata.title: DEWBIN St Patricks Day Decorations, 3 Pieces Wood St Patricks Day Decor for The Home, Leprechaun, Clover, Rainbow Irish Table Decor, Happy St. Patrick's Day Sign Farmhouse Tiered Tray Decor
features: 🍀 LUCKY DAY PARTY DECORATION - There are 3 pieces wooden St Patricks Day ornaments in each package. Each wooden sign is spray-painted on both sides, with various patterns, rainbow, leprechaun, and a jute clover decorated with green clover wooden blocks. By adopting typical elements such as leprechaun, shamrock, rainbow, holiday related words, these St Patricks Day decors cater the Irish festive theme and could definitely spice up your home!

🌈 GREEN AND GOLD ST. PATRICK’S DAY PARTY -- Host a St. Patrick's Day Dinner Party. Set the scene for a sophisticated St. Patrick's Day dinner with these simple decorating ideas.Have kids craft the cutest little leprechaun traps you ever did see! This newer St. Patrick’s Day tradition is one that everyone in your home can get in on! Celebrate Saint Patrick’s Day with unique wood gifts that make use of reclaimed wood. It’s a great way to spend time with your family.

🍀 JUST THE PERFECT SIZE -- Each romantic table centerpiece sign are in different overall size. The style of rainbow measure about 18 x 11 cm/ 7 x 4.3 inches, the clover is 14.5 x 13.5 cm/ 5.7 x 5.3 inches and the leprechaun is about 14.5 x 13.5 cm/ 5.7 x 5.3 inches. They are in appropriate size as table ornaments for catching people's attention but would not take up too much space

🌈 RELIABLE METERIAL -- The St. Patrick’s table ornament is made of wood, no bad smell and non-toxic, safe and durable, beautiful and eye-catching, can be applied with your confidence. It is also not easy to be broken or fade, can be served for many times, bringing more joy and creating happy atmosphere for your St. Patrick’s Day

🍀HAPPINESS AND LUCKY -- With Saint Patrick’s Day around the corner, you may be tempted to retrieve that leprechaun T-shirt out of your closet, or get out the corned beef and cabbage recipe. While traditions are fun, we’ve come up with a few ways to update your St. Patrick’s Day this year with some unique wood crafts. While wood may not come to mind when thinking of decorating for St. Patrick’s Day, we’ve found a few crafty ideas that are memorable, easy to make, and will last for years to come.
